lessons.title: Constitutional framework
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of constitutional framework and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: India-focused championship questions require connected knowledge of constitutional ideas, geography, history, economy, science, environment and culture. Avoid mixing institutions, dates and constitutional roles. Build timelines and maps, then connect events to causes and consequences. Focus on constitutional framework. Identify the defining concepts, common misconceptions, relevant evidence and a repeatable solving method. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify what the question tests, select the method, reason carefully, then verify the answer against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log describing the misconception rather than only recording the correct answer.
examples: A India GK Championship question on constitutional framework should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking every stated condition.
Create a new constitutional framework scenario with one tempting distractor and explain why the correct response is better supported.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused India GK Championship activity on constitutional framework: build a small table, diagram, worked example or practice set, then explain the reasoning.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on constitutional framework: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on constitutional framework without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item India GK Championship checkpoint focused on constitutional framework; target at least six correct and justify uncertain responses.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished India GK Championship task demonstrating constitutional framework and record the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction; convert errors into reusable practice rules. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving constitutional framework.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
